articles.title: DOG Mode explains Bitcoin's next governance fight
articles.snippet: Leonidas' DOG Mode client challenges Bitcoin's default relay policies, reopening a philosophical debate over censorship, free markets and who really governs the network.

articles.title: Morning Minute: Base Hands Its App Over to Cobie
articles.snippet: Plus, Stripe makes a $53 billion move that could crown a stablecoin king. And Ostium gets drained of $18M in the latest DeFi exploit.

articles.title: Another DeFi Exploit: Perp DEX Ostium Loses $18 Million in Oracle Attack
articles.snippet: Hackers manipulated Ostium's price feed by compromising an oracle signer key, allowing them to drain roughly $18 million from the Arbitrum-based perpetuals exchange.
